_about: How the organization family lens decides which organizations belong to an enumerated domain's institution and how. An organization is tied to the domain when it registered the domain, is named on certificates for the domain's names, is a registration contact for the domain using an address in it, or holds a network dedicated to the domain. A network is dedicated when an organization tied in one of the other ways holds it, or when at least dedicated_share of the names stored for it belong to the domain. Stored names reflect what was enumerated, so a large provider network can look dedicated; its holder is therefore family only by name or registration. Tied organizations are classified against the organization with the most ties: the same institution when a name is a variant of its name (proposed for merging) or the street address matches (reported only); a department when the name carries one of department_words; an affiliate when the name shares a distinctive word (not one of generic_words) with the institution's names or it registered the domain; otherwise another organization on the domain's assets, such as a hosting provider or a vendor named on a certificate. Nothing the lens finds is written to the Asset Database. Add values here, not in Go code.
